Store a dAImond Inning API key for this session

Source: R/daimond_api.R
daimond_auth.Rd

Save a personal API key so daimond_games() can read your scorecards from the dAImond Inning app. Create a key in the app under Settings, API keys. The key is kept in the DAIMOND_API_KEY environment variable for the current R session only; nothing is written to disk.

Usage

daimond_auth(key = NULL)

Arguments

key

A personal API key beginning with di_pat_. When NULL, the existing DAIMOND_API_KEY environment variable is checked instead.

Value

Invisibly, TRUE when a well-formed key is available.

Details

To keep the key across sessions, add a line DAIMOND_API_KEY=di_pat_... to your .Renviron file (for example with usethis::edit_r_environ()). Never put the key in a script you share. A key gives read access to every scorecard in the account, so revoke it in the app if it leaks.

See also

daimond_games()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
daimond_auth("di_pat_your_key_here")
} # }
